hook: The Boundary That Protects Your Mind
clips.caption:
The only boundary that matters isn't about other people.

Kevin Trudeau says the real question is whether you allow negative influence to affect you. He compares it to sitting in a car during a downpour: the rain pours down and you stay dry.

When it stops, you get out, or you carry an umbrella. He says people can say anything to him and it has zero effect, because he is at cause over his own environment.

What would it feel like to stay dry while others pour negativity?
